description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of Licence issued to "LOLC", Development Finance Plc.
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the cancellation of a finance business license for LOLC Development Finance PLC due to its amalgamation with LOLC Finance PLC. The content specifically deals with banking/financial institution regulations and commercial licensing matters under the Finance Business Act, which falls squarely within the Commercial classification (Type 6) for business and commercial regulatory matters.
